Name: Stardew Bulldozer by Hemptress
Author: Hemptress
Description:
[size=4][b]🚜 Stardew Bulldozer By Hemptress
Turn your farmer into a walking piece of heavy machinery.
Stardew Bulldozer gives you fast, satisfying farm-clearing tools without needing a tractor, giant machine, or fifty swings of an axe before breakfast.
Clear debris, harvest nearby crops, grab forage, and prepare planting areas with simple hotkeys while keeping important farm objects protected.
[/b][/size]
🌾 AUTOMATIC CROP HARVESTING
Crop harvesting is now built directly into [b]F11 Bulldozer Mode[/b].
When Bulldozer Mode is active, ripe crops within its working radius are automatically harvested as you move.
The system is designed to be crop-safe:
[list]
[*]✅ Mature crops are harvested[/*]
[*]✅ Regrowing crops remain planted[/*]
[*]✅ Immature crops are left alone[/*]
[*]✅ Growing plants are not destroyed[/*]
[*]✅ Existing crop plots are protected[/*]
[/list]You can now clear and harvest your farm during the same pass.

[heading]🎯 ADJUSTABLE TILLING RADIUS[/heading]
The F8 tilling radius can be changed in the configuration file.
Examples:
[list]
[*][code]0[/code]= only the tile beneath/near your farmer[/*]
[*][code]1[/code]= 3×3 area [b](default)[/b][/*]
[*][code]2[/code]= 5×5 area[/*]
[*][code]3[/code]= 7×7 area[/*]
[*][code]4[/code]= 9×9 area[/*]
[/list]So whether you want surgical precision or maximum farming chaos, you can choose.
[line]
🛡️ SMART PROTECTION
Stardew Bulldozer is designed to avoid chewing through the things you actually care about.
The mod attempts to preserve:
[list]
[*]Crops[/*]
[*]Immature plants[/*]
[*]Existing tilled soil[/*]
[*]Paths and flooring[/*]
[*]Machines[/*]
[*]Chests[/*]
[*]Farm buildings[/*]
[*]NPCs[/*]
[*]Animals[/*]
[*]Important placed objects[/*]
[*]Protected/tapped trees[/*]
[/list]Because Bulldozer Mode should feel powerful, not terrifying.
Well...
Not [i]too[/i] terrifying.
[line]
🎮 CONTROLS
[b]F11[/b]
Toggle [b]Bulldozer Mode[/b]
Clear debris, harvest ripe crops, collect forage and fruit, and process the surrounding area while moving.
[b]F8[/b]
Perform [b]Controlled Tilling[/b]
Tills eligible nearby soil once using your configured radius.
[line]
⚙️ CONFIGURATION
The mod includes configuration options so you can adjust its behavior to your farm.
Depending on the installed version, available settings include options for:
[list]
[*]Bulldozer toggle key[/*]
[*]Bulldozer clearing radius[/*]
[*]Scan/update interval[/*]
[*]Farm-only restrictions[/*]
[*]F8 tilling key[/*]
[*]Tilling radius[/*]
[/list]The default settings are designed to feel powerful without turning your entire farm into a crater.
[line]
🖤 WHY USE StarDew BULLDOZER?
Because clearing a giant modded farm one pebble at a time gets old.
This mod is especially useful for:
[list]
[*]Huge farms[/*]
[*]Heavily modded saves[/*]
[*]Fresh save cleanup[/*]
[*]Endgame farm redesigns[/*]
[*]Large crop fields[/*]
[*]Players who hate repetitive debris clearing[/*]
[*]Players who considered installing a tractor but thought:[/*]
[/list][i]"What if I simply became the tractor?"[/i]
That is the philosophy behind Stardew Bulldozer.

[size=4][b]✨ WHY I MADE IT
Starting a new Stardew save is fun.
Clearing the farm for the 47th time?
Slightly less magical.
Stardew Bulldozer is designed to remove some of that repetitive manual labor while still letting you physically move through the world and decide exactly where you want the automation to happen.
You're still controlling your farmer.
You're just controlling a farmer who has apparently become an OSHA violation.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]
Installation instructions
[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=4][b]Install SMAPI.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Download Stardew Bulldozer.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Extract the downloaded ZIP.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Move the extracted Stardew Bulldozer folder into:[/b][/size][/*]
[/list][code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][list=1]
[*][size=4][b]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Load your save.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Press F11.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Become the problem.[/b][/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]

Main features
[/b][/size]

[b][color=#e4e4e7][size=4]🚜 F11 - Bulldozer Mode[/size][/color][/b]

[size=4][b]Press F11 to toggle Bulldozer Mode ON or OFF.
While Bulldozer Mode is active, simply move around the area and the mod automatically handles nearby farm clutter.
Bulldozer Mode can:
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Destroy weeds[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Break stones[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Remove twigs and debris[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Clear stumps and other supported obstacles[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Protect tapped trees[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Collect nearby forage[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Harvest ripe crops automatically[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Harvest nearby fruit[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Add collected items directly to your inventory when possible[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Continuously process the area around your farmer while you move[/b][/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]No more running back and forth swinging tools at every individual object.
Become the bulldozer.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]🌱 F8 - CONTROLLED TILLING
F8 is dedicated entirely to tilling.
Instead of continuously tilling everything around you, press F8 once to till the nearby eligible ground.
The default tilling radius is intentionally small for precision.
Default:
1-tile radius = 3×3 area
This makes it much easier to create crop rows without accidentally converting half your decorative farm into soil.

Requirements
SMAPI

Shout outs
Created by Hemptress with the assistance of AI tools.
If you enjoy the mod, consider leaving an endorsement, comment, screenshot, or feedback on the Nexus page.
And remember:
The bulldozer was inside you all along.[/b][/size]
